verdict.rationale: Perplexity is an AI answer engine with page summaries and context-aware answers about the current page (docs-14, docs-25), Labs for building reports (docs-10), and Computer, which can connect to 400+ services via OAuth and run code in a sandbox whose output feeds its answers (docs-19, docs-17, docs-33). However, most of this is grounded in the web rather than the user's own data, and nothing shows proactive insights or suggestions drawn from personal or business data. A hands-on report that Computer often fails to trigger or stalls lowers confidence in the connector path (comm-7). Missing for 10: explicit analysis of user-uploaded or connected data, proactive insight or suggestion features, and independent corroboration of data-driven insights.
